title: Field caselets + bundled feature asks — rapid synthesis
body:
Purpose:
A fast, actionable synthesis of recent frontline customer signal (May–Jun 2027). Not a full roadmap — this is a compact set of micro-case studies (caselets) + bundled feature asks and an intake/validation playbook so PM/Eng/SE can run 2‑week experiments and decide what to escalate to product teams.

How to use this doc:
- Read the 6 caselets below (short customer narratives).
- Each caselet ends with: explicit ask, proposed bundle (one-liner), quick feasibility note, and a primary metric to watch.
- At the end: recommended 2‑week experiments and a simple validation playbook for CS <> SE <> PM pairing.

Summary takeaways (one-liners):
- Customers repeatedly ask for "predictable degraded behavior" when fallback models run (not just 'fallback occurred'). They want deterministic fallbacks + traceability per request.
- Embedding cost reductions + batch/async tooling are a high-impact area for mid-market analytics customers; requests are both product (quotas, async jobs) and pricing-sensitive.
- Private deployment onboarding friction is concentrated in networking/KMS steps — ask bundles should include one-click VPC templates and a preflight checker.
- Short-term wins exist: per-route cost/latency heatmaps in Console and a small SDK helper for prefix caching can buy us time while larger infra work is scoped.

Caselets
1) "Transactional chatbot keeps timing out during spikes" — fintech customer (SMB tier)
Quote: "Our users get a 502 and we lose them — we don’t care which model exactly, just that the experience stays usable and auditable."
Observed impact: Checkout flow abandonment during hourly batch jobs; ~3% revenue hit during peak 2 hours/day.
Ask: deterministic fallback policy + per-request trace showing which routing/variant was used and why.
Proposed bundle: "Fallback transparency bundle" — fallback policy UI + per-request trace logs surfaced in Console + opt-in webhook with fallback reason.
Feasibility (quick): UI + trace indexing is medium (backend logging + Console tab). Routing policy knobs exist; need small API extension to include fallback reason in response envelope.
Primary metric: % of requests with fallback + mean time-to-detect for CS (target: detect within 5 minutes).
Notes/links: Slack thread #fintech-checkout; JIRA CS-4021.

2) "Embedding bill shock" — analytics startup (growing ARR mid-market)
Quote: "We scaled a vector search index and overnight our bill doubled — we were not batching effectively and embeddings are killing the bill."
Observed impact: Unexpected monthly spend spike during index rebuilds.
Ask: auto-batching suggestions at SDK/runtime level, async bulk embedding job API, and clearer cost-estimates in Console before job start.
Proposed bundle: "Bulk embeddings toolkit" — async job API + console 'estimate & notify' + SDK helper for chunked batch creation.
Feasibility (quick): SDK helper and Console estimate are quick wins (<3 sprints). Async job + queue/backpressure infra needs SRE review (medium).
Primary metric: Estimated vs actual embedding cost variance (target: <10% variance for scheduled jobs).
Notes/links: Case recorded via SE session 2027-05-27; related GH issue: /issues/812 (embedding batching).

3) "Private deploy networking surprises" — regulated healthcare customer
Quote: "We spent two weeks on firewall rules and KMS policies and still failed the smoke test — onboarding is not plug-and-play for us."
Observed impact: Delayed go‑live; legal/infosec escalations.
Ask: one-click VPC templates + preflight networking & KMS checker + clearer docs for allowed egress.
Proposed bundle: "Private deploy preflight" — templates + interactive preflight runner (CLI + Console) + troubleshooting checklist.
Feasibility (quick): Docs + templates = quick; preflight runner requires infra checks but can be scoped as an opt-in CLI tool (2 sprints).
Primary metric: Time-to-onboard (goal: reduce average from 14 to 4 days).
Notes/links: Confluence: private-deploys/onboarding-playbook; customer ticket CS-4189.

4) "Cold-start latency for sessioned multi-turn apps" — conversational AI platform
Quote: "When a customer resumes a session the first turn is slow — users perceive the whole product as laggy."
Observed impact: Drop-off in session re-engagement; NPS comment cluster.
Ask: SDK helper to warm KV cache and an API for pinned model variants for hot sessions.
Proposed bundle: "Session warmers" — client SDK warm path + lite pinned-variant API + Console tags for session routes.
Feasibility (quick): SDK helper + Console tags trivial; pinned-variant API needs routing layer tweak but can be implemented as an opt-in policy.
Primary metric: median first-token latency on resumed sessions (target < 150ms).
Notes/links: internal perf traces (perf/team 2027-06); GH PR 498 for SDK warming patterns.

5) "Quality regressions after model swap" — mid-size SaaS search team
Quote: "We rolled a new model and search relevance dropped — we had no quick way to compare quality on our core prompt set."
Observed impact: Customer facing regression; rollback required.
Ask: built-in A/B eval harness in Console that ties to prompt sets and regression alerts.
Proposed bundle: "Eval + rollback fast path" — attach prompt sets to routes, automatic pre-deploy evals, and an easy rollback toggle.
Feasibility (quick): Eval harness requires evaluation infra + UI, but small MVP that runs limited prompt sets pre-rollout is feasible in 3 sprints.
Primary metric: % of rollouts with pre-deploy eval run (target 80%).
Notes/links: Customer provided test set (internal: cs/testsets/so_search.json).

6) "Ops blindspots around per-token costs" — platform ops at an e-commerce marketplace
Quote: "We have 40 routes and the cost is uneven — we need per-route alerting and cost-attribution per feature."
Observed impact: Cost leaks; internal debates about who owns optimization.
Ask: per-route cost budgets, alerting, and a recommended cost-optimization playbook (top-3 levers for each route).
Proposed bundle: "Route economics" — per-route budgets + automated suggestions (cache, batch, quantization) + weekly digest for owners.
Feasibility (quick): Cost attribution already exists at token-level; UI + suggestion rules are medium effort but high ROI.
Primary metric: # routes with active budgets (target: 75% coverage for top 30 routes).

Prioritization rationale (compact):
- Near-term (2–6 weeks): Fallback transparency, Bulk embeddings toolkit (Console + SDK helper), Private deploy templates, and per-route cost budgets. These are either UI/SDK work or small infra that unlocks large CS value quickly.
- Mid-term (6–12 weeks): Session warmers, Eval + rollback harness — require more infra and SRE alignment but directly reduce outages/regression risk.
- Lower priority / exploratory: full async embedding service with SLA-backed throughput (big infra + pricing design).

Recommended 2-week experiments (CS + SE + PM pairing)
Experiment A: Fallback transparency MVP
- Scope: return a 'fallback_reason' field in responses for canary customers + Console trace tab prototype visible to CS.
- Success criteria: CS can confirm and triage 5 reported incidents within the week; customers report >80% reduction in repeated support threads for the same cause.
- Steps: small API flag -> backend logs -> Console tab (mocked if necessary). Owner: Eng on-call + CS lead.

Experiment B: Embedding cost guardrails (estimate + SDK helper)
- Scope: Console estimate UI for bulk jobs + SDK batch helper that recommends chunk size.
- Success criteria: demo with 3 customers, estimate accuracy within 15%, SDK reduces naive per-item calls by >60% in test.
- Steps: prototype Console panel + 1‑page SDK sample. Owner: Devrel + Product.

Validation playbook (3 steps):
1) Triage and replicate: CS collects 3 sample requests/traffic patterns, SE replicates locally or in sandbox.
2) Quick micro-MVP: build the smallest change that addresses the ask (API flag, Console mock, SDK snippet).
3) Customer trial + measurement: run 1–2 week trial, measure primary metric and collect qualitative feedback. Document in Confluence and link back to the case file.

Acceptance criteria examples (for PM scoping):
- Fallback transparency: responses include fallback_reason in 95% of fallback cases; Console trace shows variant + trace id within 10s of ingestion.
- Embedding estimator: Console shows estimate and 'confidence band'; actual cost within displayed band 80% of the time.
- Private-preflight: preflight runner reports pass/fail for 90% of deterministic checks (network/KMS) and surfaces remediation steps.

Unresolved questions / risks:
- Data retention & privacy for per-request traces (need security sign-off; potential PII in request examples).
- Cost attribution accuracy for cross-route shared tokens (billing vs attribution mismatch).
- Engineering bandwidth: several bundles require medium infra time; need product to prioritize which to convert to roadmap.

Next steps (immediate):
- Share this doc with PMs for Hosted/Dedicated/Private w/ a 1‑page ask: pick 1 bundle to fund as a sprint-based beta. (Owners: Aisha + Marcus)
- Run Experiment A (Fallback transparency) as canary with 2 customers next week (Owners: Sofia + Eng on-call)
- Create Confluence pages for each bundle with a short RICE score and rough level-of-effort estimate (Owner: Priya)

Appendix: quick snippet templates (to share with SEs)
- SDK warming example (pseudo-code)
- Example response envelope with fallback_reason field (JSON)
- Console 'estimate job' mock wireframe notes (copyable bullets)

Contact & context:
- Logged signals pulled from CS ticket dump (May–Jun 2027), SE session notes, and perf traces. For details see linked artifacts above or ping @Aisha on Slack.

End of doc.
